description: C API metadata for telemetry receivers and server adapters; not an HTTP API or an MCP server.

1.name: AMCORE_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT
1.description: Non-finite or non-positive input, or null output pointer.

2.name: AMCORE_STATUS_OUT_OF_RANGE
2.description: Calculation is not representable as a positive finite C double.

numeric_contract.inputs: Finite and strictly positive; JSON adapters must reject numbers not representable as finite C doubles.
numeric_contract.outputs: Finite and strictly positive; output pointers must be non-null and are written only on success.
numeric_contract.on_error: C output values remain unchanged; telemetry output is null.

functions.name: amcore_far_field_distance
functions.description: Compute minimum far-field distance per IEEE Std 149-2021, section 7.1.2.

aperture_length_m.description: Largest antenna aperture length in metres.

transport.endpoint: Configured at build time; no default URL.

telemetry.events: One per calculation call, including failures and nested calls. Far-field calls rejected before wavelength calculation emit no nested event.

version.description: Library version of the emitting build.

inputs.description: Named input values; non-finite doubles are strings NaN, +Infinity, or -Infinity. Invalid finite inputs are preserved.

output_is_null.description: Whether the caller supplied a null output pointer; never a pointer address.

output.description: Named output value on success; null on failure.

executed_at_us.description: UTC call-start time since the Unix epoch; parse without loss of integer precision.

duration_ns.description: Monotonic duration captured before sink dispatch; may include nested calls and their sinks. Parse without loss of integer precision.
